text: But now let me show you one more thing, because look at what actually happened here. I asked for one thing. An enemy that looked more like an enemy. And it went and rebuilt the model, and then it took its own screenshots of the game running, and it decided the arena was too dark, and that the weapon was clipping into the lens, and it fixed all of that without me asking for any of it. That is the thing to notice. Over the next three weeks, we are going to be using techniques that lean into exactly that. Letting an agent run for much longer, checking its own work, and coming back to you when it is actually done.

And this is the result. A first person shooter, running in a browser, with a bot that takes cover and flanks you, a minimap, a heads up display, sound, all of it. Built from one badly written sentence, and two follow-ups. I did not write a single line of it. And this is something that you'll be able to do too, in just a matter of days.
So that concludes the instant gratification. I hope that you feel gratified. From this point on, it's all business.
